notes.title: New empire - Brazil!
notes.notes:
Put on your sunhat and get ready to samba – Brazil has landed in Farm Empire!

This colorful new land is bursting with life - and income potential. From tropical crops and bustling markets to mysterious wildlife, Brazil has it all. Grow your own cacao trees, spot a lazy capybara, or whip up a hearty bowl of feijoada—just don’t get lost in the jungle of profits!

Luckily, a new team of savvy managers is ready to jump in, dance through the paperwork, and help you tame the tropics. With their help, your empire will grow faster than vines in the rainy season—only more profitable.

Unlocking Brazil costs the usual 360 golden eggs, giving you access to brand-new assets, exotic animals, and a whole new world to farm in.

So head south and grow your fortune - because in Brazil, the money doesn’t just talk… it dances! Have a great trip and enjoy the brand new empire!

notes.title: New event empire: Jurassica '25
notes.notes:
Farm Empire is welcoming summer with the reopening of our popular summer empire - Jurassica! All players with access to the world map can now visit Jurassica '25, and the price is, as usual, set to 180 golden eggs.

Just like last year, you can boost your earnings by photographing dinosaurs, but this time we’ve added the option to increase your income tenfold by purchasing color photographs in the shop using gold eggs! If you run out of color photos, you can still take black-and-white pictures for free though. These changes also apply to older Jurassica empires if you choose to reopen them.

Have fun in Jurassica!

notes.title: Easter Island '25
notes.notes:
The annual visit to the Easter Island is upon us! Expand your empire with all the cozy assets found on the island, and boost your profit by painting Easter eggs. 

We also added the much wanted steam achievements for the Japan empire. 

Enjoy the Easter Island, and have a wonderful Easter month.

notes.title: Japan is here!
notes.notes:
Prepare your passports because we are ready with the next travel destination in Farm Empire: the enchanting country of Japan!

Dive into a world filled with sushi, sakura trees, and snow-capped mountains. From managing fields of fragrant green tea to harvesting the unique square watermelons, there are endless opportunities for growth and profit. And don’t forget to keep an eye on the mischievous tanuki and elegant koi carp - they’re sure to add a special charm to your empire. Arigato for your investments!

The price to unlock Japan is 360 golden eggs, giving you access to a host of new assets and managers who are as dedicated as samurai to helping you maximize your earnings.

So grab your suitcase and let the adventure begin!
We wish you an unforgettable journey to Japan!

notes.title: Xmas '24 is live!
notes.notes:
We’re back with Farm Empire’s Christmas empire, where you can create a festive atmosphere with Christmas cookies, reindeer, and jingle bells — and as always, you can earn a fortune from it all!

This year, we’ve created an entirely new mini-game for you, where you can fire up the ovens to create the perfect three-course Christmas menu. It might feature juicy duck, delicious lamb, or an amazing pie.

The mini-game is simple: start an oven with a raw dish inside, then stop the oven at just the right time to serve the finished dish. You do this by stopping the arrow above the oven when it points within the green area. Depending on whether you stop the arrow in the light green or dark green area, you’ll earn a varying amount of money, which you can spend in the Christmas empire - because who wouldn’t pay for a tasty Christmas dish? But make sure to avoid stopping the arrow in the red areas, because stopping the oven too early or too late will leave the food either raw or burnt - and nobody wants to pay for that.

If you manage to prepare the three-course menu shown on the right-hand side, you’ll also be rewarded with a boost coin visible above the dishes. This coin grows larger the better you’ve prepared the dishes.

Last but not least, you can buy Christmas spices in the Christmas empire shop! These magical spices ensure that your dishes turn out absolutely perfect, sparkling as you serve them. Using these spices adds a golden "perfect" area to the oven’s meters, leading to an even wilder payout if you hit it. Plus, if you manage to make three perfect dishes, your three-course menu will pay out even more.

So hurry into Farm Empire’s Christmas empire and serve up some delicious dishes in the new mini-game!

notes.title: Halloween is almost here!
notes.notes: From Monday September 30. the annual Halloween empire will be unlockable on the world map. The Halloween empire is filled with both creepy and delicious assets, and a fun pumpkin minigame will allow you to boost your income further than ever. The cost to unlock the Halloween empire is 180 golden eggs, and the empire will be available for the full month of October.

notes.title: Update Notes for July 25
notes.notes:
The next travel destination in Farm Empire has been decided, and this time the journey goes to beautiful Italy - available from July 31! 

The country offers all kinds of delicacies, such as pasta, pesto, and pizza - and if you are good at managing your empire, this can only result in one thing: money, money, and money! But don't just focus on these three things, as there are plenty of other raw materials that can be turned into delicious dishes and products. A true paradise for all food lovers. Molto delizioso!

This update simply prepares the release of the Italy empire, launching on July 31. No other changes included.

notes.title: Update Notes For July 10
notes.notes:
We added a new currency to Farm Empire: Crystal Eggs. Everything that used to cost money, now cost crystal eggs instead. The only thing you can purchase for money now, is crystal eggs. This greatly simplifies things on our end, when only selling one thing. Unlocking most of the new empires now cost crystal eggs, but otherwise everything else is priced similarly or lower. 

We also fixed a few minor bugs.

notes.title: Jurassica '24
notes.notes:
It's time for the annual visit to Jurassica - the dino park of Farm Empire. You will be raising T-Rex'es and other cute little dinosaurs. All just to earn a great profit of course! 

Jurassica will be available throughout June and unlocking it will set you back 180 golden eggs. As always with these event empires, once they expire you get 1 golden eggs for each milestone percentage you achieve, and they are a lot shorter than regular empires.

Enjoy your visit to Jurassica!

notes.title: New event empire - Jurassica!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43670955/339f3452ebabff2755a77b73f1881b363387ed1f.png[/img]

It's summer in Farm Empire, and our event empire Jurassica has opened! This time with free entry! This means that all players with access to the world map will also have immediate access to Jurassica. 

The empire is all about dinosaurs and other prehistoric animals. It also has a small minigame, where you can take pictures of the dinos to increase your earnings.

Jurassica is availble throughout the month of june, and once it expires you will gain your milestones in golden eggs. So for instance, if you reach 55% you will get 55 golden eggs. If you complete the empire multiple times you will get 100 golden eggs for each completion, with no limit. 4 completions and 20%? That's 420 golden eggs.

Have fun in Jurassica!

notes.title: 🐰🥚🌴Attention, farmers! The Easter Island empire is here!🌴🥚🐰
notes.notes:
Are you ready to explore a new land full of mysteries and surprises? Do you want to grow exotic crops and animals on a tropical island? Do you love colorful Easter eggs?

If you answered yes to any of these questions, then you don’t want to miss the latest update of Farm Empire! In this update, you can:

[list]
[*] Unlock the Easter Island empire for 180 golden eggs and expand your farming business across the ocean
[*] Paint Easter eggs with different patterns and colors for extra profit
[*] Discover new crops and animals that are unique to the island, such as banana, chocolate, Easter bunnies, snowdrops, daffodils and more
[*] Enjoy the beautiful scenery and music of the island
[/list]

The Easter Island empire is available only in April, so don’t wait any longer! Start your Easter Island adventure today! 🐰🥚🌴
